# [TASK] Pin real SHA256 checksums for the two Vosk archives #212 introduced

## Task
#212 (bilingual Vosk speech-to-text) switched English to
`vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph` and added German
(`vosk-model-small-de-0.15`), updating
`infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` and
`backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` to fetch both. The SHA256 checksums pinned
for these two archives in both files are placeholder zeros, not real
values — the environment #212 was implemented in has no network egress to
`alphacephei.com` to download either archive and hash it for real (the
same constraint ADR-021 documents for its own WER research). Verification
is a safe, loud failure in the meantime (`sha256sum -c` always fails on
any real download until this is fixed), not a silent bypass.

## Scope
Just the two checksums — download each archive from a network-enabled
machine, compute its real SHA256, and replace the placeholder in both
files. No code/logic changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256` in `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` (the `en` entry) set to the real SHA256 of `vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph.zip`
- [ ] `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256` (`de` entry) in the same script set to the real SHA256 of `vosk-model-small-de-0.15.zip`
- [ ] `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256` / `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256_DE` build args in `backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` updated to match
- [ ] `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` run end-to-end once against the real archives, confirming both download, verify, and unzip cleanly

## Estimate
**Hours:** 0.5

## Notes
Blocks nothing today — `develop`/CI never exercises this Dockerfile step
(`backend-ci.yml` doesn't build Docker images), and Story #200 hasn't
closed yet. It starts mattering once #200 closes and `develop` merges to
`main`, which triggers `docker-publish.yml`'s real image build — this
should land before that merge.
